description: 台灣糖業公司中彰區處小火車介紹 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣糖業股份有限公司. 湖廠區鐵道五分車行駛之可行性。 並於2003年7月19日取得五分車載客營運許可文件，正式溪湖五分車復行。 單程3. 6公里，來回約需50分鐘。 列車上有導覽解說員簡介糖業歷史沿革、鐵道文化及沿線介紹當地農特產，走向鄉村式懷舊旅程。 另外週日行駛346蒸汽火車，346蒸汽火車於1948年在比利時製造2002年溪，1949~1954年服務於溪... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣糖業股份有限公司. Its tags are 休閒旅遊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-08-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
